`final class VulkanContext`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.render` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanContext.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/render/VulkanContext.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

The device of the host seen by the Vulkan renderer, with its render passes, image and buffer creation, and one-shot submissions.

## Learn more

- [What it is made of](/build/backends/vulkan/#what-it-is-made-of)

## Creation details

<a id="VulkanContext-constructor"></a>

### VulkanContext

`VulkanContext(IVulkanHost host)` 

Reads the device of the host, its limits and its depth formats, and creates a command pool and the render pass of the offscreen targets.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when the device supports no depth format of JOID.

### check

`void check(int result, String action)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: … failed with the Vulkan error …, update the graphics driver or run with the Vulkan validation layers to find the call at fault

Throws an `IllegalStateException` that names the call when the Vulkan result is not `VK_SUCCESS`.

### TEXTURE_FORMAT

`int TEXTURE_FORMAT` 

The format of every texture and framebuffer color image of JOID, `B8G8R8A8_UNORM`.
